items.title: 67619_Big Nick Nicholas oral history interview
items.q: I was with Cozy too. And Joe Wilder was in the band, Cecil Payne and his brother, June Coles.

ctx.x: Yeah. I was on those. And Una Mae Carlisle, I made some recordings with her and him then Bobby Marshall I did some things with/on Decca, with Cozy's band, when I was with Cozy.* Oh, I forgot about Cozy. I was with Cozy too. And Joe Wilder was in the band, Cecil Payne and his brother, June Coles.
When was this that you were with Cozy? Was this '46 or something?
